summary: The registrant, Hines Global Income Trust, Inc., filed an 8-K reporting two acquisitions: Wicker Park (a retail property in Chicago) for ~$70 million (no price per share) and 405 Colorado (an office property in Austin) for ~$151 million (no price per share). Both sellers are unaffiliated. The board approved the purchases; no advisors named. The acquisitions were closed on June 23, 2026 and July 9, 2026 respectively. No premium, break fee, or financing structure disclosed. What to watch: long-term performance of trophy office recovery and retail leasing stability.
